newsitem.title: USA: Cerprobe sees $4.6 mln Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Cerprobe sees $4.6 mln Q4 charge.

text.p: Cerprobe Corp said Friday it expected to take a fourth-quarter charge of about $4.6 million for research and development and other expenses associated with its pending acquisition of CompuRoute Inc.
The company, which makes products for testing integrated circuits and microelectronics components, said it expected to complete the acquisition before the end of the year.
The charge "will enable us to enter 1997 positioned to make the acquisition accretive to earnings at the earliest point possible," Cerprobe said in a statement.
